LanguageData.Forklifts_RequireForklift: Only pawns wearing a forklift rig use pallets
LanguageData.Forklifts_RequireForkliftTip: When off, any pawn with the Hauling job can run pallet trips.
LanguageData.Forklifts_StacksPerPalletTip: How many separate stacks one pallet holds.
LanguageData.Forklifts_MinStacksTip: If fewer stacks than this can be grouped, the operator hauls normally instead of using a pallet.
LanguageData.Forklifts_PickupRadiusTip: Stacks must lie within this many cells of the first stack to join the same trip.
LanguageData.Forklifts_UnloadRadiusTip: Stacks must have a storage destination within this many cells of the first stack's destination.
LanguageData.Forklifts_LoadTicksTip: Time the operator spends loading each stack onto the pallet.
